description:
Publish the results as decided in pvm-d1-publication-scope-decision.

Default scope (option a): make the analysis durable and reviewable without touching the ranked corpus. Commit the findings summary, the analysis CSV and the methodology (versions, setups, controls, correctness rule, abort rule, disclosures) to a documented location agreed in review. The raw repetitions stay external.

If option (b) was chosen, also:
- Write setup A median bundles to results-data/bundles/polars-version-matrix/, each with a .manifest.json sidecar carrying a SHA-256 hash and the operator CPU attestation.
- Replace the hard-coded duckdb-version-matrix check in validate_corpus.py with an explicit allowlist (duckdb-version-matrix, polars-version-matrix), and update SEED_CORPUS_SPEC.md and tests/unit/scripts/test_corpus_cohort_depth.py in the same change.
- Add a CORPUS_NOTES.md section and regenerate corpus-inventory.json.
- Run validate_corpus.py.

Guardrails:
- Bundles are anonymized like the DuckDB matrix (no local paths or hostnames).
- No setup B or C bundles enter the corpus, because they would share an identity with setup A.
- Stage files explicitly by path; follow the repo PR workflow.
- Commit text describes results and methods, not session process.
